messages:
Sam (growth): Quick sync — we need final microcopy for the pricing calculator and a clear inbound routing plan before the launch tomorrow. Who can own?
Priya (PM): I can own copy. Drafted two variations for the CTA + FAQ blurbs. Posting below. Need input on tier names from product.
Priya (PM): VAR A: 'Starter / Team / Enterprise' - CTA: 'Estimate your cost'
Priya (PM): VAR B: 'Base / Pro / Scale' - CTA: 'Run the calc'
Evan (design): I prefer VAR B visually, short words fit the card layout. Will push updated mock in 10m — https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/pricing-calc (preview)
Maya (revops): Routing note: all calc submissions should create a lead with source=pricing_calc and event=calculator_submit. We should set lead score + assign to the SDR queue for >200k tokens/mo.
Alex (sales): Agree with routing. If user opts for 'Enterprise/Scale' flow, route immediately to AE queue. For others, SDR nurture.
Priya (PM): FAQ microcopy proposal (short):
- Q: 'How accurate is the estimate?'
  A: 'This is a usage-based estimate. Actual costs depend on model choices and token patterns; final invoice may vary. For exact pricing, contact sales.'
- Q: 'Can I get committed capacity discounts?'
  A: 'Yes — choose Dedicated or Private plans. Hit "Contact sales" to discuss commits.'
Sam (growth): Love the FAQ drafts. Two asks: 1) add a line about trial credits visibility, 2) make sure "Contact sales" link triggers the right routing.
Maya (revops): For the link, set utm_campaign=pricing_calc_2026 and add hidden field route_hint=calc_to_sales when tier_guess == 'Scale'.
Maya (revops): Analytics snippet that the front end should fire on submit:
```
analytics.track('pricing_calc_submit', {
  tier_guess: tier, // 'Base'|'Pro'|'Scale'
  est_monthly_tokens: tokens,
  est_monthly_cost_usd: cost
})
```
Priya (PM): A/B test plan: VAR B copy + new CTA vs current live copy. Primary KPI = calc->signup conversion. Secondary = demo requests generated. Run for 2 weeks.
Evan (design): Small UI note: when someone changes model assumptions we should keep the last values in localStorage so they don't lose progress. I'll add that to the PR.
Alex (sales): One more: can the lead payload include a short prompt snippet (first 120 chars) so AE can understand intent? Helps qualify faster.
Maya (revops): Yes, include preview_prompt field. We'll map to SFDC fields: Lead.Source, Lead.Campaign, Lead.Score, Lead.Preview_Notes. I'll create the SFDC mapping ticket.
ops-bot: Ticket created: OPS-1821 "SFDC mapping: Pricing Calculator leads" assigned to @Maya (link: https://jira.company/OPS-1821) :white_check_mark:
Priya (PM): Copy finalization: going with VAR B names (Base/Pro/Scale) and CTA 'Run the calc' — will update content on staging now.
Sam (growth): Great. Last item — email drip after calc submit for non-demo users. Maya, can you drop the 3-email sequence (value props, cost optimization tips, case study) into the nurture playbook?
Maya (revops): Yup. Will add to playbook and share sequence IDs.
Sam (growth): T-minus ~18 hours. Let's do a 15-min alignment 9:30am PT tomorrow to confirm rollout and QA. :tada:
Alex (sales): I'll be there.
Evan (design): QA checklist in the Figma file comments.
Priya (PM): Pushing staging changes now — ping here when live so revops can validate routing.
Maya (revops): Ready to validate once staging link posted.
Sam (growth): Thanks everyone — huge help.
